Hunter's Eye.description: Reveal full stats of the engaged monster — HP, STR, DEX, VIT, INT, RES and Defence. Only usable in combat.

Sanctuary.description: Surrounds the party in divine light, reducing all damage received by 10% for 60 seconds. Cooldown: 120s.

Holy Radiance.description: Calls down a pulse of holy energy, restoring HP equal to the caster's Vitality + Intelligence to every living party member. Cooldown: 120s.

Entangle.description: Halves the attack speed of the monster currently being fought for 30s. Only usable in combat. Cooldown: 60s.

Sunder Armor.description: Crushes the targeted monster, halving its defence stats for 30s. Only usable in combat. Cooldown: 60s.

Arcane Lantern.description: Conjures a sphere of magical light that illuminates the dungeon as brightly as a torch for 60 seconds. Cooldown: 60s.

Runic Scholar.description: Channels arcane power into the next spell cast, doubling its damage after all other modifiers are applied.

Mana Tap.description: Taps into a hidden vein of arcane energy, instantly replenishing all of Merlin's mana points. Cooldown: 120s.

Berserk.description: Enters a state of roaring fury, boosting all damage dealt by 20% (after other calculations) for 30s. Cooldown: 60s.

Miners Light.description: Ignites a specialized lantern, illuminating the dungeon brightly for 60 seconds. Cooldown: 60s.

Whirlwind.description: Becomes a blur of motion, doubling attack speed and preventing stamina drain for 30s. Cooldown: 60s.

True Shot.description: Becomes hyper-focused, ensuring every ranged attack finds its mark for 20 seconds. Cooldown: 60s.

Heal.description: A wave of restorative energy that mends wounds. Restores HP equal to the casters Intelligence to one party member.

Warcry.description: Lets out a thunderous shout that inspires the entire party, boosting all damage dealt by 10% (after other calculations) for 30s. Cooldown: 60s.

War Dance.description: Inspires the party with a graceful dance, increasing attack speed and preventing stamina drain for 30s. Cooldown: 60s.
